human_instruction: Finish Logistic Regression, distance-weighted KNN, Bagging, Gaussian Naive Bayes and HistGradientBoosting; then restyle the existing website using OpenCode inspiration; finish all requirements in the five original guideline documents.
model_policy: Audit existing actual fitted GNB and HistGB artifacts/CV/evaluations before deciding whether new fits are necessary. selection_policy: Compare the exact five untuned family records under the same whole-trip TRAIN CV trip-macro observation top-1 objective. Never select on student/evaluator results. Reuse a completed TRAIN-only Bayesian study only if its selected family/config/folds/objective are identical and the full trial history validates.
website_order: Do not edit frontend theme until all five actual model training/testing acceptance checks pass. Then inspect https://opencode.ai as visual reference, implement original PathSnap design with inspiration rather than copying branding.
evaluator_policy: New evaluator inputs remain unread until final family selection, model and decoder freezes are complete. Then inspect only to build separate evaluator registry/routes and run frozen inference. Reference scoring strictly postprediction, private and isolated; no evaluator input may alter model, hyperparameters, feature schema or decoder.
provenance: Student-development results have historical experimental use and are not globally blind. Explicitly disclose all reuse, calibration-in-sample and numerical build limitations.
